The FloPlast 112.5° round offset bend is a durable uPVC downpipe connector, essential for routing rainwater efficiently within drainage systems. This 68mm push-fit component offers a practical solution for new build installations and refurbishment projects, ensuring quick and easy fitting without the need for lubrication. Its robust construction and good flow capacity make it ideal for plumbers and roofers. Compatible with Polypipe, Hepworth, Osma, Hunter, Marley, Brett & Marshall Tufflex. This white offset bend provides versatile and secure rainwater management.
